title: How to compare GBP to INR transfer quotes
excerpt: A practical checklist for comparing GBP to INR transfer quotes against the live reference-rate feed.

blocks.html: Start with the live reference rate
The rate on PoundToINR is pulled from the server-side exchange-rate feed. Use it as a reference point before comparing a bank, app or money-transfer quote.

A provider quote can be lower than the reference rate because the provider may include a margin inside the exchange rate as well as any visible fee. Compare the final INR amount for the same GBP amount, payment method and delivery speed.

title: NRI banking checklist before sending pounds to India
excerpt: A plain-English checklist for choosing and checking the receiving account before sending pounds to India.

blocks.html: People sending money from the UK to India often need to check whether the receiving account is suitable for overseas income, local income or family support.
Before sending a large amount, confirm the account type, purpose code, documentation and repatriation rules with the receiving bank or a qualified adviser.

title: Why provider GBP to INR rates differ from the live rate
excerpt: Why a bank or transfer app can quote a different GBP to INR rate than the live reference rate.

blocks.html: The live rate is a reference rate, not a guaranteed transfer quote. Banks and transfer companies may apply a margin, a flat fee, speed-based pricing or payment-method charges.
The best comparison is the final INR amount received for the same GBP amount, transfer speed and payment method.

title: GBP to INR live rate source and data policy
excerpt: How the GBP to INR rate, published posts and historical snapshots are sourced on this site.

blocks.html: PoundToINR separates live reference data from editorial notes. The homepage rate is pulled from the exchange-rate feed, while articles are published through the private CMS.
Historical chart points are only shown after real snapshots are saved. The site does not backfill missing history with invented data.

title: How the GBP to INR history chart fills with real snapshots
excerpt: Why the history chart only grows from real saved GBP to INR snapshots.

blocks.html: The chart is built from real snapshots saved in Supabase. A missing day is left missing instead of being filled with an invented rate.
This makes the chart slower to grow at the start, but it keeps the public page honest and easier to audit later.

title: GBP to INR reference rate vs provider quote
excerpt: Why the live GBP to INR reference rate can differ from a bank or transfer provider quote.

blocks.html: Reference rate, not a provider quote
The GBP to INR number on this site is a reference rate from the exchange-rate feed. A bank or transfer provider can quote a different rate because of margin, fees, speed or payment method.
For a real transfer decision, compare the final INR amount received after every fee and margin is included.
